subject: Web Development
title: Private Browsing: Myths and Reality
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Private Browsing: Myths and Reality.

hook.text: Private browsing feels like invisibility mode. In reality, it's far more limited.

buildup.text: It prevents the browser from saving history, cookies, and form data after the session.

discovery.text: Your ISP, employer, and the websites you visit can still see everything you do.

twist.text: Private mode doesn't hide your IP address or encrypt your traffic. It's not a VPN.

climax.text: It protects against local snooping, not network surveillance. The name oversells it.

punchline.text: Private browsing is private from your device.

quiz.question: What does private browsing actually hide?
